available.meaning: The discovered source was fetched and mirrored successfully.

confirmed_tombstone.meaning: Every attempted canonical representation of a sitemap-discovered page returned HTTP 404 or 410. It is recorded as a stale/tombstoned sitemap entry and is no longer mirrored.

extractor_or_malformed_source.meaning: Fetched content could not be parsed or produced an invalid source shape.

partial_coverage.meaning: Only part of a source family was fetched; its prior mirror is preserved.

redirected.meaning: The source redirected successfully; the final canonical URL is recorded.

removed_from_sitemap.meaning: A previously discovered page disappeared from a complete sitemap fetch and is treated as an intentional upstream removal.

sitemap_unavailable.meaning: A sitemap or sitemap index could not be fetched completely.

source_unavailable.meaning: A complete canonical source family could not be built.

transient_page_failure.meaning: A page failed with a network, timeout, rate-limit, or server error.
